items.title: Mr. and Mrs. A.C. Synigal and B. Bozant Interview, 1962-05-17
items.q: Mr. Senegal and Miss Sandra have just stepped out for a minute.

ctx.x: That's right. Mr. Senegal and Miss Sandra have just stepped out for a minute. Let's see, better put today's date on here so we don't get it mixed up. May the 17th, 1962. Yes. By the way, this is your home here, isn't it? This is my home. We're calling it.
And by the way, it's the headquarters for the pre-old fiesta. This is headquarters.
